title: Clear Chat Command
description: plugin that clears only your own chat with one command
body:
✨ **Clear Chat Command** — a tiny, fast plugin that clears *only your own chat* with one command.

**✅ Features**
- 🧹 Clears the chat locally for the player who runs the command
- ⏱️ Shows a green "Chat cleared" action bar for 5 seconds
- 🔐 Configurable permissions (everyone or permission-only)

**⌨️ Commands**
- `/cc`
- `/clearchat`
- `/cleanchat`
- `/chatclear`
- `/chatclean`

---

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb454819f399a7a427e5425d076db8fd55cbf162_0.webp)

![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cba9dbbc1ccf1ae3bce7d310e9ecf7424b75ac3b_0.webp)

---

**🔐 Permissions**
- `clearchatcommand.use` — allows using the command
- `clearchatcommand.update` — receives update notifications on join (default: op)

**⚙️ Config**
```yaml
default-permission: true
permission-node: clearchatcommand.use
update-notifier-enabled: true
```

**🧩 Compatibility**
- Works on Bukkit/Spigot/Paper/Purpur and other Bukkit-based forks
- Built for 1.21.x and compatible down to 1.16.x
